games.title: Text Bob
games.description: A first-person psychological horror game where you chat with an AI named Bob, make choices that shape his behavior, and fight for your life... because Bob does not understand boundaries.

games.title: Roblox Archives
games.description: Archiving every corner of Roblox. Experience classic games like Natural Disaster Survival and collect tix to unlock classic items.

posts.title: Welcome to the Bandit Bros Blog!
posts.summary: Stay up to date with our latest projects, game development progress, announcements, and more.
content: Welcome to the Bandit Bros blog! This is where we will share updates, announcements, and behind-the-scenes looks at what we are building.
Keep an eye on this space for news about Text Bob, Roblox Archives, and everything else we have cooking!
